_readme: Weakness categories (id: meaning). Calibrated against 184 real CV reviews (01_sources/real_review_patterns.md sec. 2). Only novelty, overclaiming and marginal_gains separate rejecting from accepting reviews; the rest appear just as often in positive reviews.

categories.novelty: limited novelty; combination of known parts; renamed known concept
categories.positioning: difference to the closest work unclear or wrong
categories.related_work: missing or mis-described prior or concurrent work
categories.motivation: why the problem or the design matters is unclear
categories.significance: impact on the field or on CVPR readers is unclear or small
categories.baselines: missing, stale, weak or misconfigured baselines
categories.benchmarks: datasets too small, old, few or non-standard
categories.fairness: unequal tuning, budget, compute or protocol across methods
categories.statistics: no variance, seeds or significance; selection on test data
categories.ablation: components not isolated; missing or confounded ablations
categories.mechanism: claimed explanation not supported by evidence
categories.efficiency: time, memory, FLOPs or scaling missing or unfavorable
categories.theory: theory trivial, disconnected or with unstated assumptions
categories.correctness: technical or mathematical error; inconsistent numbers
categories.clarity: hard to follow; dense or ambiguous writing; undefined terms
categories.notation: symbols undefined or inconsistent; figure does not match equations
categories.figures: figures or tables illegible, misleading or not self-contained
categories.reproducibility: missing settings or details; no code statement
categories.scope_generalization: only one task or domain; unclear whether it generalizes
categories.marginal_gains: improvement too small to matter (one of three complaints that separate rejecting from accepting reviews)
categories.visual_results: insufficient or unconvincing visual results; artifacts; cherry-picked crops
categories.metrics: questionable metrics or protocol (metrics that do not test the claim, train-set-only evaluation)
categories.sensitivity: hyperparameter sensitivity or robustness not analysed
